name: product-engineering
description: Agent skills for the whole product lifecycle with coding agents, from deciding what to build to shipping and growing it, from The Product Compass.

plugins.name: product
plugins.description: Decide what to build before building it: find where the work stands, research an idea and propose hypotheses with their sources in a prototype you review, then competitors and segments, the value proposition, the value curve, the beachhead segment and growth loops.

plugins.name: ai-shipping
plugins.description: Ship AI-built apps: document the app, review it for correctness, security and performance, prove it with a test harness that fakes the right side, and release through a gate with the owner's go. Where the free pm-ai-shipping plugin moved: turn that one off once this is installed.

plugins.name: agent-teams
plugins.description: Work with other coding agents as partners: brief any delegate with the why, drive the Codex CLI as builder and peer, run an unsteered independent review through the Grok CLI or a fresh Claude session, and let other agents drive Claude Code headless.

plugins.name: agent-harness
plugins.description: Make your own agent setup reliable: instruction files that are met at the moment they apply, rules held by hooks instead of prose, status that survives context compaction, the handover the next session starts from, a session's friction turned into a setup fix, and the Windows shell traps that break agents.

plugins.name: app-stack
plugins.description: Build a SaaS app with coding agents on Next.js, Supabase, Clerk and Netlify: the path from idea to production, multi-tenant authorization, the production choices for Supabase and Clerk, environments and secrets, product design, uptime monitoring, cookieless analytics, legal pages, remote MCP servers, ChatGPT plugins and embedded Claude agents.

plugins.name: work-humanizer
plugins.description: Edit AI-sounding work writing so it reads like a careful person wrote it, without changing what it says — or interview the writer and build the piece from their answers.
